label: Whatever moves something exists at the reading world w
paraphrase: OPEN interface (B0), analyst formulation, attribution deferred: on the shared causality frame, whatever moves something in some respect (MovesIn, CAUSE_1, read at the reading world w, since the case's motion vocabulary is not world-indexed) exists at w. A mover exercising its moving there exists there. Nothing is said about any other world, about concreteness or about necessity. Scope: B0 is warranted only at the world at which MovesIn is read; at any other world it would itself assert that the movers exist there, and at every accessible world it would make every mover necessary. 'Moves' is the frame's MovesIn, meaning DEF-MOTION-AS-REDUCTION (CAUSE_1); that definition is deliberately not linked here, because the arguments using B0 also use CAUSE_2 (causing esse) as a different relation and the sense check cannot tell two relations from an equivocation. The missing link is recorded for #216.
